title: Malicious code in @c1-ease/autoloan (npm)
description: The npm package @c1-ease/autoloan contains malicious code that executes a postinstall script and triggers on import. It sends system information to a hardcoded external server over HTTPS with disabled certificate validation, enabling data exfiltration. The package uses dependency-confusion naming to masquerade as an internal namespace, causing silent execution in build and CI environments.
